bio1.en: I am a Mechatronics Engineer with more than five years of experience building software, automation, and applied AI solutions for energy, environmental, restaurant, and service operations.

bio2.en: I am the technical founder of Alliafood, a restaurant platform that connects WhatsApp ordering, AI agents, real-time operations, thermal printing, and analytics.
bio2.es: Soy fundador técnico de Alliafood, una plataforma para restaurantes que conecta pedidos por WhatsApp, agentes de IA, operación en tiempo real, impresión térmica y analítica.

bio3.en: My core stack includes Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, n8n, and AI models. I select tools based on the product context, not on trends.

bio4.en: I work best where engineering decisions stay connected to business context, users, and measurable outcomes. I can lead technical direction and remain close to implementation.

faqDesc.en: A few direct answers before you decide whether it makes sense to talk.

faq1Q.en: What kind of problems can I help solve?
faq1Q.es: ¿Qué tipo de problemas puedo ayudar a resolver?

faq1A.en: Operational platforms, internal tools, quoting and service workflows, applied AI, process automation, system modernization, and production readiness.
faq1A.es: Plataformas operativas, herramientas internas, flujos de cotización y servicio, IA aplicada, automatización de procesos, modernización y salida a producción.

faq2Q.en: What happens after the first message?

faq2A.en: I clarify the problem, users, constraints, and desired outcome. Then I propose a realistic first scope, milestones, and the technical path.
faq2A.es: Aclaro el problema, los usuarios, las restricciones y el resultado esperado. Después propongo un primer alcance realista, hitos y el camino técnico.

faq3Q.en: Can we start with a limited scope?

faq3A.en: Yes. A focused diagnostic, prototype, or first operational workflow can reduce risk before expanding the product.
faq3A.es: Sí. Un diagnóstico, prototipo o primer flujo operativo bien enfocado permite reducir riesgo antes de ampliar el producto.

faq4Q.en: How long will the project take?

faq4A.en: It depends on the scope and the starting point. Before implementation, I define milestones and make the delivery assumptions visible.
faq4A.es: Depende del alcance y del punto de partida. Antes de implementar, defino hitos y hago visibles los supuestos de entrega.
